source.notes: in: current = the player's Lockpick CreatureSkill.Current (ACE's, from init/ranks/sac/attr); add = the lockpick's PropertyInt.LockpickMod (null = unset); mult = its PropertyFloat.LockpickMod (null = unset); difficulty = a lock's ResistLockpick. out = [GetEffectiveLockpickSkill, GetSkillChance((int)effective, difficulty)], the chance LockHelper.Unlock rolls ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0f, 1f) against.
